member.name: T:SAAC.Groups.SimplifiedFlockGroupsDetector
member.summary: Simplified model detection for detecting groups inspired by Flock agents (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/1605401). Uses a variant of Reynolds rules: * Flock Centering: attempt to stay close to nearby flockmates (distance). * Collision Avoidance: avoid collisions with nearby flockmates (same direction in movement). * Velocity Matching: attempt to match velocity with nearby flockmates (velocity).
